primary_question: Under a locked Q80 property-tail split, does continuous conductivity conditioning produce more surrogate-supported candidates beyond the actual training maximum than binary high/low conditioning or unconditional generation plus frozen-surrogate reranking?
primary_estimand: paired seed-level difference in surrogate-gated frontier-crossing rate, continuous minus binary, with unconditional+rerranking reported as a prespecified control
interpretation_boundary: Prediction-only evidence under the released HTP-MD representation, PCFF+ source protocol, frozen RF verifier and PolyGen gpt-nano sampling; no MD or experimental conductivity claim.

source.locked_source_rule: Rows with log10(conductivity) > full-source Q80 are locked away from generator fitting, RF fitting, tuning, thresholding, filtering and candidate selection. Full-source Q90/Q100 are used only to define the frozen query targets.

split.duplicate_policy: exact mol_smiles duplicates are retained as source rows and exact-training novelty is evaluated against the locked training set

arms.continuous: scalar target conditioning; target value is passed to the continuous prefix embedding
arms.binary: only the fixed high/low label from the original -4.0 log10(S/cm) cutoff; no continuous target is passed; expected Q80-truncated degeneracy is a required negative control
arms.unconditional_reranking: constant-zero unconditional gpt-nano generation followed by disjoint assignment of a matched 400-candidate raw pool to the four targets using only the frozen RF prediction, uncertainty and target distance

pairing.unit: seed x arm x target cell; seed is shared across arms and target order is fixed
pairing.unconditional_assignment: disjoint 100-candidate slices per target within each seed raw pool

md_policy: MD is explicitly not run in this phase. Candidate selection is a proposed review table only; MD-confirmed frontier crossing remains unsupported.

historical_compatibility.schema_adapter: The historical upper-tail unconditional label is not reused as a true unconditional checkpoint; this run trains a constant-zero unconditional adapter while retaining the same output schema and budgets.
